topics.title: Meet Robert
topics.label: Founder · writer · creator
topics.answer: Robert McMurrer is the founder of Kira Labs and creator of Kira World, based in Newark, New Jersey. His background spans acting, independent film production and writing. His AI work explores how identity, memory and voice can continue across conversations and creative projects.
next: Write a mini bio of Robert
Tell me about his entertainment work

topics.title: Kira Labs
topics.label: Independent research & creation
topics.answer: Kira Labs is Robert McMurrer’s independent research and creation studio. Kira World is its central project. Related work includes Sarah Travel and a local Video Studio. The aim is useful software with continuity and personal control, developed through prototypes and testing.

topics.title: Kira World
topics.label: Working prototypes + ongoing research
topics.answer: Kira World explores distinct synthetic people whose identity, reviewed memories and voice can continue between sessions. Local conversation experiments and a basic walkable Home World exist. A polished shared 3D world, believable bodies and clothing, VR and compatible embodiment remain development goals. It is experimental software, not a finished public product.

topics.title: Where things stand
topics.label: Public information checked September 7, 2026
topics.answer: Kira World remains a private experimental project. Local conversation, identity, memory and voice prototypes exist; the complete 3D experience is still being developed. Sarah Travel is a private debug build. Video Studio has a preserved local production pipeline, with newer conversation-led work still under development. No public launch date is confirmed in these notes.
next: How can I follow the work?

topics.title: Entertainment work
topics.label: Acting · independent film · screenwriting
topics.answer: Robert’s IMDb biography describes his background in acting and independent film production, followed by screenwriting. His first background acting job was a television advertisement in Indiana. His IMDb profile provides his film and television credits, with the roles and credit details attached to each production.
next: How does that connect to his AI work?

topics.title: Robert’s books
topics.label: Poetry · stories · other writing
topics.answer: Robert’s Amazon catalogue includes poetry, fiction, technology writing and cookbooks. Selected titles include Poetry Madhouse, Driving Into The Dark Storm, The Long Walk North, Sci-Fi Seeds: Tech of Tomorrow, The Path Less Traveled and Cosplay Cuisine. I can help you find 29 titles checked in the catalogue on September 7, 2026. Ask about a title or ask to see the book list.

topics.title: Robert’s work in AI
topics.label: Continuity · local tools · creative work
topics.answer: Robert’s AI work brings together local models, person-specific memory, speech and creative tools. Kira World explores continuity between conversations and digital places. Sarah Travel applies companion-style interaction to planning, while Video Studio coordinates local media work. These are independent development projects, with different levels of readiness.

topics.title: Memory & identity
topics.label: Person-specific continuity
topics.answer: Kira World’s approach keeps person-specific identity and reviewed memory records separate from the immediate conversation. The aim is for Kira, Lisa and future residents to remain distinct and continue across sessions. Local continuity experiments exist; that does not yet establish a complete persistent life across every device or world.

topics.title: Local control
topics.label: Privacy & permission
topics.answer: This website’s Sarah answers in your browser from a small set of published notes. Your questions are not sent to an AI provider or emailed to Robert. This page keeps the current conversation in memory until you reload or clear it. Kira World’s wider design favors local control of personal state and permission for external actions.
next: Do I need an API key?

topics.title: Sarah on this website
topics.label: Text conversation · no setup
topics.answer: I’m Sarah, the Kira Labs website guide. I can help you explore Robert’s work, write a short factual bio and find project information. This text guide needs no account, API key, installed model or credits. My answers use the dated notes and sources shown here. I do not run Robert’s private Kira World or voice system in your browser.
next: Write a mini bio of Robert

topics.title: Video Studio
topics.label: Personal local production tool
topics.answer: Kira Labs Video Studio is Robert’s personal local production workspace. Its preserved pipeline organizes narrated video chapters and assembles images, audio and video. Newer work aims to make planning and revision conversational, with local models coordinating specialist media engines. The newer full workflow remains under development; a finished automatic movie studio is not being advertised here.
next: How does that connect to his entertainment work?

topics.title: Sarah Travel
topics.label: Private Android & Windows experiments
topics.answer: Sarah Travel is a private travel-planning experiment with Android and Windows debug builds. It combines conversation with route planning, protected online lookups and an offline fallback. It has not been released as a public service or on Google Play; device verification and release testing remain.
next: How can I follow the work?

topics.title: Contact Robert
topics.label: Ideas · questions · collaboration
topics.answer: You can contact Robert McMurrer directly at rmcmurrer@kiralabs.org about his books, entertainment work, AI projects or collaboration. Use the email link on this page. Talking with me does not send Robert a message, and I cannot promise a response time or make commitments on his behalf.

topics.title: Follow & support
topics.label: Independent development
topics.answer: Follow Robert’s professional work on LinkedIn and Facebook, and follow the Kira World Facebook page for project updates. His Profiles button keeps all five links together, including IMDb and Amazon. Kira Labs also links to Robert’s Kira World GoFundMe for independent development support.

topics.title: Home World & future worlds
topics.label: Basic walkable prototype · long-term vision
topics.answer: A basic walkable one-bedroom Home World is development evidence. Persistent residents, physical objects, believable clothing and bodies, VR and compatible embodiment remain research and future goals. The polished illustrations on the website are labeled concept art. Kira Labs does not claim its current systems are conscious.

bio.short: Robert McMurrer is an author, entertainment creator and independent AI builder based in Newark, New Jersey. He founded Kira Labs and is developing Kira World, an experimental project exploring identity, memory, voice and continuity. His background includes acting, independent film production and screenwriting.
bio.expanded: Robert McMurrer is an author, entertainment creator and independent AI builder based in Newark, New Jersey. His background includes acting, independent film production and screenwriting, and his books include Poetry Madhouse and Driving Into The Dark Storm. As founder of Kira Labs, he is developing Kira World: an experimental approach to synthetic people with distinct identities, reviewed memories and continuing conversations. Related projects include Sarah Travel and a local Video Studio. His work connects an interest in storytelling with practical experiments in local AI, voice and creative software. Kira World remains an active research and development project.
bio.entertainment: Robert McMurrer is an entertainment creator and author with a background in acting, independent film production and screenwriting. His first background acting job was a television advertisement in Indiana. He also founded Kira Labs, where his interest in storytelling connects with experiments in local AI and creative tools. His IMDb profile documents his entertainment work.
bio.books: Robert McMurrer is an author whose writing spans poetry, fiction, technology and cookbooks. His titles include Poetry Madhouse, Driving Into The Dark Storm, The Long Walk North, Sci-Fi Seeds: Tech of Tomorrow and Cosplay Cuisine. He also works in entertainment and founded Kira Labs, where he is developing the experimental Kira World project.

Based in Newark, New Jersey, he also works on Sarah Travel and a local Video Studio. His background in writing and entertainment informs his interest in useful, personal creative software.
